title: Judah al-Ḥarizi, *Taḥkemoni*
author: Judah al-Ḥarizi (about 1165 – 1225)
summary: The Hebrew maqamat that were the model for Immanuel's *Maḥberot*, with an English translation line by line: the introduction and all fifty gates.
